about: Trucks: a big diesel by revs, its start and stop, the engine brake, air brakes, the air horn, the reversing alarm and the heavy cab door.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A big diesel truck idles: a deep heavy diesel clatter and rumble with a faint turbo whistle, constant. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy diesel truck pulls away at low revs: a deep labouring diesel growl, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy diesel truck at middle revs: a loud steady diesel roar with a turbo whistle, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy diesel truck at high revs: a loud straining diesel roar and turbo whine, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the starter grinding and the diesel catching

prompts.text: A big diesel truck engine starts: the starter grinds, the engine fires with a heavy clatter and settles into a rumbling idle, two separate starts with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big diesel truck engine is switched off: it shudders, knocks and dies, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy truck slows on its engine brake: a loud rapid barking rattle from the exhaust, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy truck's air brakes release a loud sharp hiss of air, five separate hisses with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big truck's loud air horn blasts, short and long blasts, four separate blasts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A truck's reversing alarm beeps steadily, beep, beep, beep, constant. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy truck's cab door slams shut with a solid metal bang, five separate slams with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
